description.narrative: Frontclear mobilizes the funds from investors to issue guarantees against local currency collateral assets (e.g., treasury bonds) held by the financial institution (Obligors), to allow the financial institution to access liquidity in the money market by borrowing from other banks (Beneficiaries).

activity-date.narrative: The maturity date of the self-liquidating sub-notes is a bullet repayment after 15 years with its scheduled exit date being in December 2034. FSDAi has the option of extending the maturity of the notes by a further 10 years to December 2044.
